scripts.lint: cd backend && go test ./... && go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.12.2 run --path-mode=abs
scripts.sqlc: cd backend && go run github.com/sqlc-dev/sqlc/cmd/sqlc@v1.31.1 generate
scripts.api: npm run api:spec && npm run api:ts
scripts.cloud:build-worker: cd backend && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -o /tmp/ao-worker-linux-amd64 ./cmd/ao-worker
scripts.cloud:server: set -a; . ./.env.cloud.local; set +a; cd backend && go run ./cmd/ao-cloud
scripts.cloud:test: set -a; . ./.env.cloud.local; set +a; cd backend && go test ./cmd/ao-cloud ./cmd/ao-worker ./internal/cloud/...
